source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Filtration, printed as a second 15.1 with Figures 15.1 to 15.4, pages 324-326.

blocks.text: Filtration do ajza wale heterogeneous mixture ke ek juz ko solution se alag karti hai. Pehle munasib solvent chuna jata hai jis mein ek juz poori tarah hal ho jabke doosra amalan na hale. Aam namak aur ret ke mixture ke liye, mixture distilled water mein hal kiya jata hai: namak poore pani mein phail kar homogeneous mixture deta hai, pani mein aam namak ka solution, jabke ret bina hale rehti aur beth jati hai. Namak solute aur pani solvent hai, solvent woh juz jo zyada miqdar mein hai. Phir filtration ret ko alag karti hai.

blocks.alt: Ek haath tirchhe beaker se mixture sheeshe ki chhar (glass rod) ke saath filter paper wale funnel mein dal raha hai; funnel stand ke clamp mein hai aur neeche beaker mein filtrate ke qatre gir rahe hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.1: Filtration ka amal (process) (kitab ki Figure 15.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki is tasveer par koi label nahi. Mixture ko seedha funnel mein nahi phenkte balkay glass rod ke saath aahista dalte hain taake chhitke nahi. Funnel stand ke clamp mein hai; filter paper par ret (residue) rukti hai aur namak ka solution (filtrate) neeche beaker mein jata hai.

blocks.title: Solute, solvent, solution, filtrate aur residue
blocks.text: Solution mein hal shuda madda solute aur zyada miqdar wala liquid solvent hai. Filtration ke baad funnel ke neeche flask mein jama liquid filtrate hai, aur filter par bacha solid residue.

Sheeshe ke funnel aur filter paper se filtration aam taur par sust hoti hai: jaise mixture dala jata hai, solvent guzar jata hai, muallaq zarraat kaghaz par chhorte hue. Filter papers mukhtalif porosities (soorakh ke size) mein milte hain, precipitate ke zarraat ke size ke mutabiq chune hue; kaghaz itna bara ho ke aakhir mein ek chauthai se aadha precipitate se bhara ho, taake filtrate chhitke baghair beaker ke kinare se utre (Figure 15.1). Kaghaz aadha, phir dobara aadha mora jata aur cone mein khola jata hai, 60-degree funnel mein rakha, pani se geela kar ke dabaya jata hai (Figure 15.2a).

blocks.alt: Teen khaake: gol filter paper jis ke beech dashed lakeer (pehla mor), aadha daira jis par aari dashed lakeer (doosra mor), aur kaghaz ko khol kar bana cone.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.2a: Filter paper ko morna (folding) (kitab ki Figure 15.2a ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Conical funnel se filtration ki raftar fluted filter paper se bohat barhti hai, jo pankhe ki tarah bari bari ubhar aur gehrai ke saath mora jata hai (Figure 15.2b).

blocks.alt: Saat qadam: filter disk; aadha morein; phir aadha morein; chauthai hisse ki silwat; aathwein hisse ki silwat; pankhe jaisi accordion shakal; khula filter cone.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.2b: Fluted (silwat-dar) filter paper (kitab ki Figure 15.2b ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teer ka rukh dekhein: oopar ki line baayen se daayen, phir neeche aa kar daayen se baayen. Har mor par kaghaz par nayi silwat (crease) banti hai; aakhir mein kaghaz pankhe ki tarah ubhar aur gehrai wala ho jata hai, is liye funnel ke saath hawa ka raasta rehta hai aur filtration tez hoti hai. (Kitab ki caption mein 'Fluttled' chhapa hai; sahih lafz 'Fluted' hai.)

Precipitate crucible se suction ke zariye bhi filter kiya ja sakta hai. Gooch crucible porcelain ka hai jis ka soorakh-dar pendah kaghaz ke pulp ya size ke mutabiq kate filter paper se dhaka hota hai (Figure 15.3); suction apparatus mein rakh kar yeh jaldi filter karta hai, aur un precipitates ke liye mozoon hai jo zyada darja hararat par jalane hon; soorakh asbestos ki chatai se dhak kar yeh kaghaz se react karne wale solutions, jaise ghaliz HCl aur KMnO4, filter kar sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Safed porcelain ka crucible ulta rakha hai taake us ka soorakh-dar pendah (perforated bottom) nazar aaye; paas ek alag soorakh-dar disc aur ek gol plate.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.3: Gooch crucible (kitab ki Figure 15.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Sintered glass crucible mein pendah mein masamdar sheeshe ki disc jari hoti hai aur koi tayyari nahi chahiye (Figure 15.4).

blocks.alt: Sheeshe ka crucible jis ke neeche ke hisse mein safed masamdar (porous) sheeshe ki disc jari hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.4: Sintered glass crucible (kitab ki Figure 15.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gooch crucible porcelain ka hai aur us ke pendah ke soorakhon par kaghaz ka pulp ya filter paper rakhna parta hai. Sintered glass crucible mein masamdar sheeshe ki disc pehle se jari hai, is liye koi tayyari nahi chahiye. Dono suction (vacuum) ke saath istemal hote hain.

rows: sust; precipitate ke liye soorakh ka size chuna hua; kaghaz ek chauthai se aadha bhara
pankhe ki tarah mora; conical funnel se bohat tez

blocks.prompt: Istemal hone wale filter media batayein, gravity filtration ko vacuum filtration se, aur Gooch ko sintered glass crucible se alag karein (Quick Check 15.1a, c, d; exercise Q.2c).
blocks.explanation: Media: saada aur fluted filter paper, kaghaz ke pulp ya asbestos wala Gooch crucible, aur sintered glass crucible. Gravity filtration liquid ko apne wazan se kaghaz ke cone se guzarne deti hai aur sust hai; vacuum filtration use suction se crucible se kheenchti hai aur tez hai. Gooch crucible porcelain ka hai jis ke soorakh istemal se pehle pulp ya asbestos se dhakne parte hain, aur ise jalaya ja sakta hai; sintered glass crucible mein bani-banai masamdar sheeshe ki disc hai, tayyari nahi chahiye, magar ise zor se garam nahi kiya ja sakta.

items: Filtration: halne wala juz (solute) solvent mein hal karein, filter se guzarein; na-halne wala residue rukta hai, filtrate guzarta hai (ret se namak).
Media: 60-degree funnel mein kaghaz ka cone (sust), fluted kaghaz (tez), Gooch crucible (suction, jalana, HCl aur KMnO4 ke liye asbestos), sintered glass crucible (tayyari nahi).
